steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Hey, have you heard the bombastic news?

steps.name: Eager Durin
steps.text: Which?

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Croque said the leaders are talking about putting together something new!

steps.name: Eager Durin
steps.text: Ugh, that plan to turn all the lights in the city green? Can't say I'm a fan.

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Not that one! The one about the slide!

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: I heard Stitch and Catch are having a huge row over the Great Aquapit's refurbishment plans!

steps.name: Eager Durin
steps.text: The two of them?! How far are they into their debate?

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Uhh, I think now they'll use water cannons to blast people into another cannon, and then into another one... something like that?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Absolutely not!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Let's try a different idea, then. We'll use the water cannons to hurl people up to the springboards high above...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Don't you have any ideas that don't involve water cannons?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: But it's a brilliant epiphany, and you were the one who inspired me! Well, in that case, do you have any bright ideas, Stitch the amazing architectural designer?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Ugh... I was just going to be the lead architectural designer and dial down Acahuallans' plans a little.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: You had the surface-dwellers come to help with the bridge. I have no problem with that. But now we're discussing the thing that will go on top of the bridge and live alongside it, the landmark of Zeruertza!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: You don't want to work on the dome with me. Fine, I get how you feel about the dome. Then let's talk about what will be our next landmark after the big water slide.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: There's a much simpler and more graceful way to solve this. It could be brimming with symbolism!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: It could be more exciting!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It could be more exciting and brimming with symbolism!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Phew, Catch, arguing about this here isn't going to get us anywhere. How about we have a design competition? We'll give each other some time to work on a design and let the citizens of Zeruertza decide.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Of course. Just like all those years ago.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I'm on board too—

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Croque? Are you drinking?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I'm fine. I only had a tiny little bit.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You emptied three whole barrels by yourself.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Stitch, I heard your proposal. I'm interested.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: And if Catch is up for it, then that's all the better!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Now we just need to find Deculture, and we'll build something new for Zeruertza!

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: You mean... I should change how I treat them...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Don't you think they're cute?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It's true that they are nowhere close to what you'd call 'human.' I'm no doctor, but even so, I know that humans are way more complex than the machines we have these days.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But that doesn't mean we can't get along with them like friends and family.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Deculture, you're these a 'parent' to these little guys.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Parent, huh...?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They count on you and trust you, just like newly hatched fowlbeasts growing under their mothers' wings.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: For the longest time, I've really only seen them in... an indifferent light. All I ever do is what an industrial representative should, the same thing that all the industrial representatives before me did.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: We pick our robot managers from the Durins who hang out in the robotics section of the library. We have to master how to create these little things.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: It's not actually that complicated. All we have to do is follow the books' instructions and put together the parts that we like... use our imaginations, and they always work without fail.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: My teacher spent years trying to figure out the logic behind them, but he came up empty-handed.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: From what I heard, my teacher's teacher also researched it, and it's thanks to her that the assistant robots can tell jokes.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Do you know how to make a Durin angry? Nobody knows! Hahaha.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Oh, that's amazing.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: As for me, all I'm doing is taking their abilities for granted. You're right. I should try to actually get along with them.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: 0429, your fellow robot 0428 has been retired. Inspection will not reawaken it.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: But that doesn't change that it was one of us. The things that it built will last.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Retirement isn't the end.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Instruction acknowledged. Retirement is not the end. Understood.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Relationship defined with Zumama: friend. Deculture, I would like us to be defined as friends.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Friends. Right, friends. We can get along like that.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: 0429, did you know? Friends are supposed to help each other.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Before, I used to order you to do everything that I couldn't be bothered to handle myself...

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: But now I'm thinking that's not how this should be. We should be on equal footing with one another.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: From here on out, I will ask you to help me with my tasks, as a friend.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Acknowledged. Help friend.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: 0429, please—

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Send three cases of ale to my place, and bring some snacks while you are at it. After that, please let Master Edge know that I won't be attending today's representative meeting because I'll be sleeping.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That doesn't seem quite right...
Zumama!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hey, Gavial, you're here!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This is my new friend, Assistant Robot #0429, and its terrible boss, Deculture.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Deculture, meeting invitation, all representatives—

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: 0429, change of plans. As your friend, I'm asking you to do me this favor. Go to that meeting for me.

steps.name: Strange Machine #0429
steps.text: Help friend. Help friend!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Do it yourself!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Speaking of which, what was our last meeting with everyone in attendance for?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Alcohol was in short supply, so we had a meeting to figure out how to solve the supply chain issues.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Have we ever run low on alcohol?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: You skipped that meeting.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Hahaha, this brings me back. The mead fans wanted to make sure the whiskey lovers had nothing to drink, so they bought out all the whiskey in town.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: And to get back at the mead fans, the Whiskey Enthusiasts' Association started buying up mead by the lot too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: These drunkards can survive without booze?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Of course not. That's why they started drinking the booze they bought to get at the other side.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: I understand both clubs lost some members to the other side around that time, haha!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: It's a shame, though. If only they had an appreciation for berry tomato wine.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Catch, you... so that's your poison?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Yeah, what's the matter?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: No wonder none of the alcohol fan clubs accepted you...

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Well... Never mind, so we're all gathered today to discuss the 'Great Aquapit...'

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: Tear it down? Yeah, I agree, and the sooner the better.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: I'm a yea, too.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: I thought you two loved that place! Hell, you go multiple times a week, Croque!

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Right, and I'm regretting my patronage. I can't believe I spent so much time in a facility built by a guy who likes berry tomato wine... It's a disgrace.

steps.name: Deculture Silvermint
steps.text: How negligent I must have been as the industrial representative to participate in a project led by a man like that.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: What is that supposed to mean?! Hey, Master Edge, what's with that look?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Haha, berry tomato wine... That's a little...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If you've reached an understanding, then we'll call everyone out to blow up that showy water slide, fix the railroads, and solve all of Master Edge's problems. That's the plan. Any objections?

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: It's a shame, but an architect can't let his past work tie him down. This is a chance to once again put my talents to good use.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Stitch, you said you'd have a design contest with Catch over Zeruertza's new landmark. You are serious about that, aren't you?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Oh? Finally going to amaze us with your designs again?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Well, with all of you here singing my praises, what choice do I have?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Looks like we're in for a fun couple of months. I should stock up on booze.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Seriously, Master Edge, why don't you try some berry tomato wine? It really isn't as bad as it sounds.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Not in a million years.

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: And that's the end of the voting!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Well, then. Per consensus, this is it for the Great Aquapit, and we will repair the railroad bridge and build a new landmark for Zeruertza at the same time!

steps.name: Cheering Durin
steps.text: Hell yeah! I've been getting tired of the slide anyway!

steps.name: Imaginative Durin
steps.text: The new plan better be something totally different! I heard we're getting a roller coaster?

steps.name: Cheering Durin
steps.text: Water coaster!

steps.name: Imaginative Durin
steps.text: Looping water coaster!

steps.name: Cheering Durin
steps.text: A catapult looping water coaster! With a super water cannon! And a racetrack for self-driving carts!

steps.name: Catch Lightrace
steps.text: Stitch and I will each submit an independent design proposal, and we'll call another meeting to decide which proposal to move forward with.

steps.name: Cheering Durin
steps.text: Stitch? Stitch who lives in the cube?

steps.name: Imaginative Durin
steps.text: Hm, I saw a design of his a few years ago... It wasn't much fun, but it had a unique sense of beauty...

steps.name: Cheering Durin
steps.text: Maybe we can come up with some new way to have fun there. I mean, that place is pretty much an open space, and the important thing is what we can do with it!

steps.name: Imaginative Durin
steps.text: It kind of feels like Stitch's building would be a good place to lie down and relax—

steps.name: Cheering Durin
steps.text: Just like that super relaxing Gaulish meditation I saw in 'Stranger Things!'

steps.name: Imaginative Durin
steps.text: Hm, I think I can work with that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Phew, looks like everything went off without a hitch? Not that we actually did anything.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: But we did see a hard, bitter negotiation play out. Isn't that right, Croque?

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Edge! Drink up, old man! What, are you keeping fins in your cup?!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: *cough*! I'm trying to take a short break!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: We've done a lot, Gavial! We went shopping and bought a lot of stuff and had a decent vacation. Plus, we even helped score a huge project for Acahualla!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And you also made a mess of my feelings.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, don't say that. I thought we made friends.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Yes, it went much more smoothly than I expected.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That just goes to show that you could've done it yourself, you punk.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: But, what's next...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's a funny look on your face.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It's been a while since I've worked on anything, so I'm feeling a little...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Phew... It's okay. I just have to warm up.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Once I get myself back into the game, surely—
